periodMappingScope: Reuse the existing 24-period NEMS timestamp-floor verification; retain original UNVERIFIED_FLOOR metadata and validate zero offset, source and publication time. This does not independently verify every later provider revision.
originSelection: First eligible fresh original LIVE solar issue in each half-hour; no later-input reconstruction
truthSelection: Latest verified-mapping provisional vintage received by trainCutoff or testEnd respectively
trainingPurge: All 24 target half-hours must end and their actual prices must be received before trainCutoff
fitWindow: One explicit fit after trainCutoff and before testStart; missing this window invalidates this prospective schedule
review: Compare MAE/RMSE overall, ordinary and spike periods, each horizon, both test weeks, fixed-lead early events and false runs; then use the real F4 savings replay before any adoption
savingsGate: Identical household profiles and feasible windows through the existing F4 optimizer; compare total savings, harmful moves and loss against frozen solar and B3, retaining losing weeks
stopRule: One candidate and one matched solar-only control; no grid search, repeat tuning, or automatic promotion. If demand does not improve the matched control and current-system outcomes, retain current model and report the failure.
